features.title: What makes Klive different

@feature.allInOne.tag.context: Short label above the feature heading, shown in capitals.

feature.allInOne.title: One app. Zero glue.

@feature.allInOne.title.context: Feature heading: Klive needs no other tools to be installed and configured. Keep it short and punchy.

feature.allInOne.short: Emulator, editor, assembler, BASIC compiler and debugger, built to work together.

@feature.allInOne.short.context: One-sentence version of the feature, in a coloured block.

feature.allInOne.text: Start from a template for the 48K, 128K, +3E, Next or Z88 and press Run. Elsewhere this takes an assembler, an editor, an emulator and a debugger bridge, configured by hand.

@feature.allInOne.text.context: The feature's paragraph. Machine names are never translated.

feature.allInOne.point1: Compile, inject, run and debug with one click
feature.allInOne.point3: Works with sjasmplus, Boriel BASIC, z88dk and PASTA/80 when you want them

@feature.allInOne.point3.context: Bullet point. Tool names are never translated.

@feature.basicDebug.tag.context: Short label above the feature heading. 'ZX BASIC' is never translated.

feature.basicDebug.title: Step through your BASIC, line by line

@feature.basicDebug.title.context: Feature heading: source-level debugging of compiled BASIC programs.

feature.basicDebug.short: Breakpoints on statements, a call stack, and variables you can edit.

@feature.basicDebug.short.context: One-sentence version of the feature, in a coloured block.

feature.basicDebug.text: Klive's built-in ZX BASIC compiler, compatible with Boriel ZX BASIC, debugs at the source level: breakpoints on statements, Step Over and Step Into, a real call stack, live variables, and stops on runtime errors.

@feature.basicDebug.text.context: The feature's paragraph. 'Step Over' and 'Step Into' are command names: use the translation the Klive app uses for them.

feature.basicDebug.point1: No installation: the compiler is built in
feature.basicDebug.point2: Compatible with Boriel ZX BASIC and NextBuild's CODEBANK

@feature.basicDebug.point2.context: Bullet point. Product names and CODEBANK are never translated.

feature.basicDebug.point3: Editor help: completion, go to definition, rename

@feature.timeTravel.tag.context: Short label above the feature heading.

feature.timeTravel.title: Go back in time

@feature.timeTravel.title.context: Feature heading: the debugger can run the machine backwards.

feature.timeTravel.short: Step backwards through the whole machine: memory, devices, the screen.

@feature.timeTravel.short.context: One-sentence version of the feature, in a coloured block.

feature.timeTravel.text: Step back through every instruction with memory, devices and the screen restored. Find the last write to a byte, continue from the past, and save a whole session to open elsewhere.
feature.timeTravel.point1: On every Z80 machine Klive emulates
feature.timeTravel.point3: Debug recordings: send the bug, not a description

@feature.speaksNext.tag.context: Short label above the feature heading. Product name: never translated.

feature.speaksNext.title: Speaks Next natively

@feature.speaksNext.title.context: Feature heading: Klive understands the ZX Spectrum Next's hardware.

feature.speaksNext.short: NextReg breakpoints, bank-aware debugging, .nex files with palettes and Copper.

@feature.speaksNext.short.context: One-sentence version of the feature, in a coloured block. 'NextReg', '.nex' and 'Copper' are never translated.

feature.speaksNext.text: Break when a program writes a Next register, with value and mask filters and old-to-new values. Set breakpoints on banks rather than addresses, program the DMA with a readable syntax, and build .nex files with palettes, Copper lists and loading bars.

@feature.speaksNext.text.context: The feature's paragraph. 'DMA', '.nex' and 'Copper' are never translated.

feature.speaksNext.point1: A Next core written from the FPGA's VHDL

@feature.speaksNext.point1.context: Bullet point. 'FPGA' and 'VHDL' are never translated.

feature.speaksNext.point3: NextZXOS boots from an emulated SD card

@feature.testing.tag.context: Short label above the feature heading.

feature.testing.title: Test it like modern code

@feature.testing.title.context: Feature heading: unit tests, coverage and profiling for Z80 programs.

feature.testing.short: Unit tests, code coverage and a profiler, in the IDE and in CI.

@feature.testing.short.context: One-sentence version of the feature, in a coloured block. 'CI' (continuous integration) is usually left as is.

feature.testing.text: Write unit tests for your Z80 routines and run them headless, with exact T-state timings. See which lines ran with code coverage, and where the time goes with a profiler.

@feature.testing.text.context: The feature's paragraph. 'T-state' is never translated.

@feature.testing.point1.context: Bullet point. 'DeZog' is a product name.

feature.testing.point2: JUnit XML and LCOV output for CI

@feature.testing.point2.context: Bullet point. 'JUnit XML', 'LCOV' and 'CI' are never translated.

@feature.disassembly.tag.context: Short label above the feature heading.

feature.disassembly.title: Disassembly that explains itself

@feature.disassembly.title.context: Feature heading: the disassembly view shows what each branch will do.

feature.disassembly.short: Branch verdicts with their T-state cost, system variables by name.

@feature.disassembly.short.context: One-sentence version of the feature, in a coloured block. 'T-state' is never translated.

feature.disassembly.text: Every conditional branch shows whether it will be taken and what it costs in T-states, worked out from the live flags. System variables appear by name, and you can measure the T-states between any two points.
feature.disassembly.point2: Labels and comments you add, everywhere
feature.disassembly.point3: A ULA view of the beam, contention and the floating bus

@feature.nex.tag.context: Short label above the feature heading.

feature.nex.title: Open a .nex. Understand it.

@feature.nex.title.context: Feature heading. '.nex' is a file extension: never translated.

feature.nex.short: Debug any NEX file without a project, and keep your notes beside it.

@feature.nex.short.context: One-sentence version of the feature, in a coloured block.

feature.nex.text: Debug any NEX file with no project and stop at its entry point. Compare a bank with the file on disk, name routines as you find them, and keep your labels, comments and data regions in a file that is there next time.
feature.nex.point3: Copper lists and DMA programs decoded

@feature.nex.point3.context: Bullet point. 'Copper' and 'DMA' are never translated.
